name: segmented
title: Segmented
description: Segmented control — a single-select, always-one-selected view/mode switcher on a muted track with a raised active chip.

meta.whenToUse: Peer view/mode switches where one option is always active — view modes, billing cycles, filter scopes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content panels swapping (Tabs), meaningful empty/multi selection (ToggleGroup), or on/off (Switch).
